dos.text: Always set title even though it isn't shown by default, moz-page-nav can collapse and hide the slotted label text, and title is what keeps the button identifiable once that happens.
Set view to a value that really matches one of the parent moz-page-nav's view ids, activate() compares it directly against the parent's currentView.

donts.text: Don't try to control selected from outside to force a switch, it's managed by the parent moz-page-nav based on currentView, not a real standalone toggle.
Don't set both href and supportPage expecting one to layer on the other, href only takes effect when supportPage isn't set.
